# Neurologic Exam

**Authors:** Jorge S. Rangel, Ria Monica D. Asuncion

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The neurologic examination is an assessment tool used to determine a patient's neurologic function. This evaluation is beneficial in multiple ways, as it assists in the localization of neurologic diseases and supports the process of ruling in or ruling out differential diagnoses. Neurologic diseases can manifest through a wide range of cognitive, behavioral, visual, motor, or sensory symptoms. Certain red flags identified during examination allow early detection of life-threatening neurologic conditions and recognition of disorders that may negatively affect quality of life.
